physicalNotes: Radius 0.11151772 Jupiter radii from Murgas et al. 2023 (2023A&A...677A.182M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract): 7,972.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Murgas et al. 2023 (2023A&A...677A.182M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01290004 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
